definitions outside the repository (typeshed, site-packages) are not followed
an outline item (lsp_symbol) names every symbol it lists

## Response format

Respond with a single fenced JSON object and nothing else:
```json
{"reasoning": "<short explanation>", "symbols": ["<fully.qualified.name>", "..."]}
```
`symbols` lists every affected symbol by exact fully-qualified name.
